seo.title: Advocacy · Ontario Rare Action Group
seo.description: Six commitments shape every meeting, every brief, and every campaign we bring to Queen's Park.

header.title: What we are fighting for.
header.lede: Six commitments shape every meeting, every brief, and every campaign we bring to Queen's Park. They were written by patients and caregivers — and they're updated each year alongside our community.

goals.title: A Provincial Rare Disease Strategy
goals.desc: Implementation of Canada's National Strategy at the Ontario level — with funding, accountability and patient governance built in from the start.
points: Standing patient council with binding input

goals.title: Faster, fairer diagnosis
goals.desc: Universal newborn screening expansion and reimbursed genetic testing, so families don't wait years for answers.
points: Newborn panel aligned with U.S. RUSP

goals.title: Equitable drug access
goals.desc: A transparent, patient-informed reimbursement pathway for rare-disease therapies — including pediatric and ultra-rare medications.

goals.title: Caregiver and family supports
goals.desc: Recognition of unpaid caregivers in provincial labour and benefit policy, including respite and mental-health funding.

goals.title: Coordinated, multidisciplinary care
goals.desc: Designated Centres of Expertise across Ontario so rural and northern patients receive the same standard of care as those in the GTA.
points: Centre of Expertise per Health Region

goals.title: Research investment
goals.desc: Dedicated provincial funding for rare-disease research, registries and patient-reported outcome programs.
